title: {{NAME}} and the Dinosaur Who Needed a Robot Heart
moral: Everyone deserves kindness, even if they seem different.

pages.content: {{NAME}} walked into a deep green jungle. Big dinosaurs stomped through the trees. Tiny fairies flew high above the ferns. A small copper robot sat on a rock by itself. It looked at the dinosaurs walking past. The robot waved but nobody waved back.
